style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas Details Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: Celebrate a baby s first Christmas with this personalised Father Christmas bauble. It can be personalised with the child s name, date of birth and First Christmas year, displayed on the Christmas tree. The design is printed onto a shaped wooden insert and displayed inside a clear glass bauble with artificial snow, finished with a velvet ribbon in a colour of your choice. A timeless personalised Baby s First Christmas decoration, Santa bauble and keepsake gift.
